measurement: Windows QueryThreadCycleTime and Instant on logical CPU 2; 200 ms untimed encoder warmup and identical iteration counts per pair in direct-warm and subsequent reports. First cold allocation counts exclude encoder construction and PCM fixture creation.
individual_rounds: 11 x approximately 100 ms per variant, plus untimed warmup; 21 x 150 ms for the added 32-bit noise case.
final_rounds: 15 x approximately 150 ms per variant, plus untimed warmup, 9 cases.
bitwise_reference_test: 7,800 fields (0..64 bits, five values, eight initial offsets, three clear/reuse passes), long unary prefixes, padding, invalid width and failure-state preservation.
heap: All 9 final cases remove one cold allocation and retain zero allocations and reallocations after warmup. Requested-byte totals include repeated reallocation requests; not RSS or retained heap.

discarded.word_without_small_append: word.json: 4.8% slower smooth16-l0; replaced with explicit zero-byte/one-byte appends.

limits: Synthetic resident-frame encoding on one variable-frequency Intel i7-1250U host. Counter outliers and whole-process power-state differences remain in raw rows; neither decoder nor playback throughput is measured. External oracle gates were not rerun.
